    The handbook · 2026 Edition

    The CREED handbook

    The rules for the Wayne State app stack, chapter by chapter. Each chapter states what the ADRs have already decided, with the ADR number, and marks the rest as "To be decided".

    Eleven chapters · 105 provisions · MUST 14 · SHOULD 2 · MAY 1

    How to read this book

    §3.2
    Chapter 3, section 2. Every section number is a link to itself: copy it to cite the rule.
    MUST SHOULD MAY
    The RFC 2119 key words, set in small capitals so a requirement never hides in a sentence.
    (the stack's version policy)
    The decision a rule comes from. Rules state what is decided and cite it.

    "To be decided": the gap is printed, and no rule is stated in its place.
